name: Sashimi

cells.what: Fish renamed as they grow: inada, warasa, buri; seigo, fukko, suzuki
cells.why: Size and age change the fish, and the market names follow
cells.regional: Kantō says inada, Kansai hamachi; Toyama has up to five stages

cells.what: Raw fish pressed between kombu, or cured in vinegar
cells.why: Kombu draws out water and adds umami; the fish firms up
cells.regional: Toyama is the kobujime prefecture; swordfish is its standard
cells.safety: Vinegar does not kill anisakis; shimesaba needs freezing

cells.what: Bonito with citrus-vinegar and soy dressing
cells.regional: Always with sliced garlic in Kōchi
